notes.95: P-01 | WEST SERVICE SUPPLY | REV A | SYNTHETIC DESIGN
notes.96: Native CAD: millimetres. Plans are full-size. System diagram is NOT TO SCALE.
notes.F8: 1. Scope: new SUP from S-IN to U-OUT, including the connection between levels.
notes.F9: 2. Plan dimensions and coordinates locate horizontal pipe centrelines in millimetres.
notes.FA: 3. Riser R-A in the plans and system diagram represents the same physical riser.
notes.FB: 4. Pipe CL elevations are in metres from the project datum; FFL is not pipe CL.
notes.FC: 5. The system diagram explains connections and elevations; do not scale its drawn lengths.
notes.FD: 6. Centreline quantity includes continuous length through inline fittings. No fitting allowances.
notes.FE: 7. DN changes at the indicated reducer centre; there are no unshown offsets in this task.
notes.FF: 8. Lines crossing without a filled junction dot are not connected; DRN is outside SUP scope.
notes.100: 9. End ports define the measurement limit. Do not add lengths beyond S-IN or U-OUT.
notes.101: 10. The legend is explanatory only. No waste, insulation, supports, or cost quantities requested.
